games.name: Pretend to be AI
games.desc:
Originally this game was centered around:
"
Pretend to be AI is a puzzle roleplay game where you can either:
- Play as a detective, trying to figure out if the person you’re talking to is an AI.
- Play as an impostor, attempting to convince the detective that you are an AI.
"
However, due to TOS and legal changes requiring the disclosure of all AI interactions, the game is non functional right now. Thanks to everyone who played.

games.name: Trident Survival
games.desc:
Gather resources, craft, loot, steal, build, and survive in a world where the only enemy is other people. Trident Survival brings a unique experience of Player vs Player survival. Play solo or team up with friends to take others resources, while defending your own from others trying doing the same.

Your location, items, and buildings will be saved on the server you join automatically.
Servers reset and remove all buildings every Friday @ 2PM EST.
Use of exploits is not tolerated. Exceeding max clan member limit will result in a ban.

Available Platforms:
- PC
- XBOX

Key binds can be found and changed in settings tab.
